verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor-published incident postmortems, no live trust/status page, and no disclosure-history documentation for Microsoft Entra ID. Community commentary instead highlights opacity around vulnerabilities (e.g., a CVSS 10.0 RCE where commenters note 'since it was a fixed vuln in a closed-source cloud-based service, we will likely never have any more information'), reinforcing the absence of transparent postmortem practices rather than supporting them.
